About

Ozan Ferhat Şen

Professional practice and academic development focused on real estate, construction and zoning law

Professional and academic focus

Ozan Ferhat Şen began his legal education at Dicle University Faculty of Law in 2010. As construction and real estate law matters became an increasingly significant part of his professional practice, he pursued the Master's Program in Real Estate and Construction Law at Istanbul University Institute of Social Sciences in order to deepen his knowledge and experience in the field academically.

His professional work focuses particularly on real estate, construction, zoning and related legal disputes. Outside law, his principal area of work is mathematics teaching.

Şen's interest in mathematics is not limited to a personal pursuit; he also continues to work in mathematics education and content production. He has taught as a guest instructor at Nesin Mathematics Village and continues his work in mathematics education under the Matematik Departmanı platform.

The analytical approach developed through mathematical practice also forms an important part of the way he breaks down and evaluates complex legal issues.

Ozan Ferhat Şen is married and has one daughter.
